name: Desktop UX Consistency
notes: V15.2.0 desktop UX consistency: clearer month-navigation and filter-selection feedback, inline form validation, unified destructive confirmations, per-action Settings busy states, discoverable Search shortcuts, and plain-language Cloud Sync recovery messaging. Finance Schema 12, Cloud Schema V3, saved records, calculations, account balances, budgets, projects, five-minute sync cadence, and phone layout remain unchanged.
